stop.prompt: Before this agent turn ends, evaluate: Did the agent make any file edits in this turn that FIXED something (corrected a bug, fixed a discrepancy, corrected documentation, added a missing gate/rule)? If YES: Does the agent's response contain a structured postmortem with ALL 7 elements (Bug定位, 根因, 测试漏洞, 修复, 防护测试, 同类排查, 预防方案)? Also check: Was RELEASE_NOTES.md updated if code changes were made? If the answer is YES-fixes-exist but NO-postmortem-missing or NO-release-notes-missing, return a followup_message asking the agent to complete documentation before finishing. If no fixes were made, or everything is complete, allow the stop. Here is the context: $ARGUMENTS
